command_name.description: The name of the command to wrap with readline capabilities.

history_filename.description: Path to the file for storing command history.

completion_files.description: List of files containing completion word lists to be loaded by rlwrap.

histsize.description: Maximum number of entries to keep in the history list. Use 0 for unlimited or negative for read-only.

history_filter_regex.description: Regular expression pattern. Input lines matching this pattern will be excluded from history (case-insensitive).

prompt_substitute.description: Text to substitute for the command's native prompt. Useful if the command has no prompt.

prompt_color.description: ANSI color name or spec (e.g., Blue, Yellow, 1;31) for the prompt.

wait_timeout.description: Time in milliseconds rlwrap waits after receiving output to determine if it is a prompt.
